title: "The Cat in the Hat" 3rd Weekend Box Office
description:
This market will resolve according to how much "The Cat in the Hat" will gross domestically on its 3-day third weekend (November 20 - 22).

This market will resolve as soon as a final (i.e., not studio estimates) third weekend figure is available, and no later than December 22, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. The primary resolution source is the third weekend figure in the "Weekend Box Office Performance" table on the "Box Office" tab of this movie's The Numbers (https://www.the-numbers.com/) page. If The Numbers does not have a final figure by December 22, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve according to the "Weekend" figure for the movie's third weekend on the "Domestic Weekend" tab of this movie's Box Office Mojo (https://www.boxofficemojo.com/) release page.

If neither source has a final figure by December 22, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve according to the figure The Numbers reports at that time, or, if The Numbers reports none, the figure Box Office Mojo reports at that time. If neither source reports any figure by December 22, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to the lowest bracket.

If the reported value falls exactly between two brackets, then this market will resolve to the higher range bracket.

This market will resolve according to the figure for the 3-day weekend, regardless of whether domestic refers to only the USA, or to USA and Canada, etc.
